title: LegendaryCrateTracker
description: Legendary Crate Opening Tracker on simplesurvival.gg (/legcounter)(/legitems)
body:
Type /legcounter to see how many Legendary Crates you have opened on the server you execute the command on.

Type /legitems to see the exact items you won and the exact time you won them.

**If you are crashing or getting kicked, its not the mod. You have the wrong requirements installed or are not on 1.21.3 Fabric.**

Correct 1.21.3 Cloth Version Download: [https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config/version/16.0.143+fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config/version/16.0.143+fabric)

Correct 1.21.3 FabricAPI Version Download: [https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.114.0+1.21.3](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/version/0.114.0+1.21.3)

Correct 1.21.3 Fabric Language Kotlin Download: [https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin/version/1.13.1+kotlin.2.1.10](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin/version/1.13.1+kotlin.2.1.10)

Correct 1.21.3 ModMenu Version Download: [https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/version/12.0.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu/version/12.0.0)
